# What to ask each department for

*Generated by `node tools/exec-coverage.mjs --asks` from the same probe as the full requirements pack — every state was tested against the repository, not asserted. `†` marks a required field.*

**21 factors we have fully · 12 partially · 25 not at all.** A factor marked *fully* needs nothing from anyone outside this repo — it is either already read or ours to wire.

## Performance — 25% of the business score

**Ask for nothing.** All 8 factors are ours: GWP vs target (MTD, incl VAT) · Sales vs target · Sales per day vs tenure target · Conversion vs tenure target · QA score (mean of agent means) · Cancellation rate · Insurance opt-in rate · Agents rated 70+ (share of floor).

- Outstanding on our side: **Insurance opt-in rate** — `opt`†, `optPct`†.

## Two rules to put in the request itself

- **Dates** — ISO, YYYY-MM-DD. Never 03/04 — that is two different days in two countries. A time goes in its own column as HH:MM (24h).
- **Empty cells** — Leave a cell blank when there is no value. Never 0, never N/A, never a dash — an absence is not a nought, and the report is built to tell them apart.

*Full column tables with types and examples are in `DATA-REQUIREMENTS.md`, part two.*
